articles.title: Papa León XIV en Lima: las 12 rutas de su visita, cierres de avenidas, desvíos y tramos en papamóvil
articles.summary: El avión que transportará al Papa aterrizará, aproximadamente, a las 5:30 p.m. del miércoles 11 de noviembre y, luego, se dirigirá a Palacio de Gobierno para reunirse con la presidenta Keiko Fujimori.
articles.body_text: A pocos días del arribo de León XIV al Perú, ya se definieron las vías por las cuales el sumo pontífice recorrerá para asistir a los eventos en los que participará durante su estancia en la capital y el Callao. Se ha determinado que el Papa recorra 12 rutas. El avión que transportará a Robert Prevost aterrizará, aproximadamente, a las 5:30 p.m. del miércoles 11 de noviembre. La comitiva papal se desplazará por las avenidas Faucett, La Marina, Sucre y Brasil. A la altura del colegio Salesiano San Francisco de Sales, se subirá al papamóvil. Todo el desplazamiento del líder de la iglesia católica será vigilado por un helicóptero. Luego, el Papa recorrerá plaza Bolognesi, Paseo Colón, Av. Garcilaso de la Vega, Av. Tacna, y subirá por el jirón Conde de Superunda. En la plaza Mayor recorrerá sus alrededores y entrará a Palacio de Gobierno para reunirse con la presidenta Keiko Fujimori. Su arribo será entre las 6 p.m. y 6:15 p.m. Como medida de seguridad, la Policía ha establecido un área de restricción que comprende la Av. Tacna, Av. Emancipación, Av. Abancay, el jirón Amazonas y la parte trasera de Palacio de Gobierno. El corredor Azul se desviará por la Av. Alfonso Ugarte, mientras que el corredor Morado se desplazará hacia la Av. Huánuco. Tras su reunión con la mandataria, León XIV se trasladará, al promediar las 7:15 p.m., al Gran Teatro Nacional, en San Borja, por lo que se cerrará los accesos a la Av. Aviación. Ante ello, unas 15 rutas de transporte público convencional modificarán sus recorridos por las avenidas Canadá, Guardia Civil, San Borja Norte y La Cultura. Además, la estación La Cultura de la Línea 1 del Metro permanecerá cerrada. Asimismo, los servicios 201, 204, 206 y 209 del corredor Rojo dejarán de realizar paradas en el paradero La Cultura en la av. Aviación Al día siguiente, el 12 de noviembre, el sumo pontífice volverá a realizar un recorrido en papamóvil por los alrededores de la plaza Mayor para acceder a la Catedral de Lima. En su visita al Estadio Nacional, León XIV entrará por el cruce de las avenidas 28 de Julio y Paseo de la República, la calle José Díaz, e ingresará por la tribuna de occidente. Las autoridades han dispuesto los cierres de los accesos vehiculares en la intersección de las avenidas 28 de Julio y la Av. Paseo de la República, así como en Av. Petit Thouars. Su salida será por la tribuna de occidente, tomará la calle José Díaz, Av. Petit Thouars para dirigirse a la Nunciatura Apostólica, ubicada en la avenida Salaverry. Para participar en la misa en la base Las Palmas, a desarrollarse el 16 de noviembre, el Papa ingresará por la avenida Jorge Chávez. A la 1 p.m. se dirigirá al Grupo Aéreo N°8 para despegar rumbo a Roma. Medidas de seguridad La Policía ha establecido tres anillos de seguridad durante los eventos en los que participará el Papa. El primer anillo estará a cargo de agentes de la Dirección de Seguridad del Estado y miembros de la seguridad personal del sumo pontífice. El segundo y tercer anillo será cubierto por el personal policial básico de las diferentes regiones policiales de las ciudades donde el Papa permanecerá, así como por agentes de las unidades especializadas, los cuales serán previamente capacitados y reentrenados. En Lima, se desplegarán 22,464 agentes PNP, quienes brindarán servicio en la zona de los escenarios y se colocarán en las rutas hacia los eventos. En regiones, habrá 14,685 policías. Cerca de 2.000 policías de tránsito estarán a cargo de las rutas, cortes y desvíos en Lima, mientras que 24 vehículos motorizados integrarán la escolta del pontífice, informó el jefe de la Dirección de Tránsito de la Policía Nacional, general Humberto Alvarado López. El uso del papamóvil El desplazamiento del Papa, tras su llegada del Grupo Aéreo N°8, el 11 de noviembre, será en un vehículo cerrado hasta la avenida Brasil por un tema de “tiempo y de seguridad”, indicó monseñor Guillermo Inca Pereda, secretario general adjunto de la Conferencia Episcopal Peruana. Remarcó que, a partir de la Basílica de María Auxiliadora, en la avenida Brasil, el recorrido será en papamóvil hasta su llegada a la plaza Mayor de Lima. Al día siguiente, el sumo pontífice saldrá en un vehículo cerrado de la Nunciatura Apostólica, en Jesús María, y luego se subirá, a la altura del Centro Cívico, en el papamóvil y avanzará por la Av. Garcilaso de la Vega y Tacna. En el Santuario de las Nazarenas se detendrá y hará una breve oración ante el Señor de los Milagros, y luego llegará a la Catedral a través del Jr. Conde de Superunda. Mario Casaretto, gerente de Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres de la Municipalidad de Lima, indicó a El Comercio que la Policía colocará vallas altas en los alrededores de los eventos del Papa, mientras que las vallas bajas serán colocadas en el jirón Conde de Superunda y en el contorno de la plaza Mayor. En las grandes avenidas, los agentes policiales realizarán una labor de contención para impedir que personas invadan la vía o impidan el avance de la comitiva papal.

articles.body_text: Apple TV is making its content more accessible to Deaf audiences with the launch of a new Sign Language Interpretation feature, the company announced on Tuesday. The feature will initially be available across a limited set of titles, starting this Friday with the release of “ Being Heumann ,” a biopic about disability rights activist Judy Heumann. American Sign Language (ASL) and British Sign Language (BSL) will also be made available for Apple’s hit movie “F1.” Later this year, other titles will follow, including “Way of the Warrior Kid” and “Greyhound.” What makes Apple’s offering different from other platforms is that the sign language version of the film is not a separate product — that is, it’s not a separate film designed just for Deaf viewers. Instead, Apple’s support for sign language is just a setting you enable that’s integrated with the main title, similar to how you could turn on or off closed captions. When a title with the sign language option is playing, an interpreter appears in the bottom right of the screen, translating the spoken words into signs. Apple says it has partnered with a group of DASLs (Directors of Artistic Sign Language) to ensure that the interpreter for each film fits the tone of the film. Notably, the company is not using any AI-generated interpreters, as Apple says that’s not what the Deaf community has said it needs. The feature is shipping in the latest release of iOS 27.2, and can be turned on through a new sign language option in Settings. After being enabled, a new button will appear in the supported Apple Original titles on Apple TV indicating that sign language is available. These titles are labeled with a sign language icon that appears on the title page alongside other features like closed captions or audio descriptions. There’s also a new section under languages that will list the specific sign languages that are available with the given title. To make the titles more discoverable, Apple TV will highlight which titles include the sign language option in a “Movies & Shows with American Sign Language” editorial collection. Meanwhile, users can easily surface supported titles via search by typing in keywords like “with ASL,” for example. The new feature builds on Apple’s other investments in accessibility features, which it builds itself. “At Apple, we believe everyone should be able to enjoy great stories and entertainment,” said Sarah Herrlinger, Apple’s senior director of Global Accessibility Policy and Initiatives, in a statement about the launch. “Bringing sign language interpretation to Apple TV is an exciting step forward in making the viewing experience more accessible and inclusive for Deaf audiences. Accessibility is a core value at Apple, and we’re proud to continue creating experiences that allow more people to enjoy the content they love,” she added. articles.title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Google's new tensor processing units (TPUs) broaden its chip portfolio to more use cases: confidential model training and more memory capacity.
articles.body_text: Google is notching up its chipmaking game as the company seeks to reduce its dependence on chips made by other companies for its cloud computing business. Google on Monday unveiled two new variants of its tensor processing units (TPUs), in-house developed chips meant for AI workloads, that broaden its chip portfolio to additional use cases: confidential inference and more memory capacity for large workloads. The new units, TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max, are part of the company’s eighth generation of chips introduced in April this year, and build on what those chips offered, which was more inference capacity and support for large training requirements. TPU 8tx, designed with AMD, is based on the TPU 8t chip, and is geared specifically for confidentially training and running AI models, Google said in a blog post. The chip “builds security directly into the hardware layer, keeping sensitive data and model weights protected and isolated even while in active use,” the company wrote. The chip also has a custom inferencing network that lets it run reasoning alongside training, so it can be used to distill and train small models on the fly. That ability, according to Google, could prove useful for cases where a company might want to train a model on its proprietary data without having to move the data between devices. Meanwhile, TPU 8i Max basically combines two of the inference-focused TPU 8i chips the company launched in April, doubling the memory capacity, processing power and bandwidth, but in a single package. The result is a chip that lets AI models handle a larger range of information during queries. The chip launch comes as hyperscalers like Microsoft , Amazon , and even AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic are working on their own lines of AI-specific semiconductors and accompanying software in order to reduce their reliance on the dominance of Nvidia. The news also comes at a particularly vulnerable moment for Nvidia, whose CEO Jensen Huang over the weekend admitted to having an affair with someone alleged to be a Chinese spy. articles.title: N-able takes its remote access service offline after researcher publishes dozens of zero-day bugs | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The remote access giant also urged its self-hosted customers to take down their own servers amid a "critical security incident," fearing the possibility of cyberattacks.
articles.body_text: Remote access company N-able has confirmed it took down its cloud-hosted offering to fix a slew of security vulnerabilities that were published online this week, giving the company no advance notice to fix them. In a status update on its website, the company said its hosted N-Central offering for customers is now offline “while we take the necessary actions to secure the environments and implement appropriate remediation.” The company also urged customers to take down their own self-hosted deployments of N-Central, fearing that attackers could use the publicly disclosed exploits to hack into customer networks. N-able said during this time customers will not be able to use their N-Central service, which allows corporate customers to remotely access and manage other devices and systems on the same network. Remote access technologies are a frequent target of hackers, as these systems can grant vast access to a company’s network and internal data. Security researcher Ben Bales released the “zero-day” bugs on GitHub on Sunday. In a post on X , Bales dubbed the bugs Able2Shell, describing them as a mix of vulnerabilities capable of stealing credentials, creating new administrative accounts, and gaining root access to affected N-able systems. Bales told Bleeping Computer that he publicly released the bugs as the company allegedly failed to patch the flaws reported in a different product. N-able said that it has no evidence of successful exploitation against any of its customer environments. A spokesperson for the company did not respond to a request for comment about whether it has the ability to check, such as server logs, or if it has no way to check. articles.title: Reddit is turning user conversations into AI-powered product reviews | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Reddit's new AI-powered reviews summarize what users like and dislike about 10,000 products, helping shoppers research purchases ahead of the holidays.
articles.body_text: Shortly after announcing a plan to transition its site to a logged-in experience , Reddit is debuting a feature that could help make it more of a destination for people doing product research via the web. The company on Tuesday introduced “Reddit Reviews,” a feature that organizes conversations about products into dedicated reviews that include the highlights and key takeaways from users across its communities. The company notes that the new experience builds on one of the ways people are already using Reddit: to learn from others what products are really like, and how they fit into their everyday lives. These first-hand accounts and recommendations can help consumers determine whether or not a particular product is right for them. However, given the rise of generative AI and bots, it’s an area that’s also ripe for “astroturfing” — a term that refers to when a brand fakes public support. With Reddit now effectively turning what was casual online research into more of a structured product, it could become a larger target for these types of fake reviews and recommendations than before. To address this, Reddit’s announcement points to its rules and its latest measures to combat automated abuse and spam , as well as its practice involving community moderators, as tools it will use to keep the reviews on the site legit. The Reddit Reviews feature itself taps into AI to organize the conversations people are having where they describe their product experiences. These posts will often see users discussing how a product works for them, or why it fails, or what the trade-offs are that someone should consider before buying. The company has been testing the product reviews feature since February, initially with U.S. users in areas like Electronics, Video Games, and Health & Beauty products. In September, Reddit expanded the test to include the Home & Garden and Fashion & Apparel categories as well. Now, the company says Reddit Reviews is rolling out to all U.S. users on iOS, Android, and web, with an initial selection focused on around 10,000 products. Over time, it will roll out to more categories and expand beyond the U.S. To use the feature, Reddit users can search for a product or category in the app’s search bar or click on a highlighted product name they see in someone’s comment. From there, the user is taken to a screen where important conversations are summarized under a “what people are saying” heading. This will also include a visual breakdown that shows how many of those comments are positive, negative, or mixed, and what sort of things people said they liked or disliked about the item. For instance, a user considering buying an espresso machine might want to know about things like how much counter space it takes up or whether it’s easier for beginners to understand how to use it, says Reddit. Users can then browse the comments, filter them by topic, or click to be taken to the original conversation, where they can ask more questions or get advice. Users can also move from one product review back to the full category to weigh other, similar products that have been discussed to compare their options, the company said. The feature arrives just ahead of the busy holiday shopping season, when people spend a lot more time doing online product research ahead of their bigger purchases. articles.title: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share to reach an implied valuation of $1.404 trillion | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The company could end up being worth a hefty $1.404 trillion if its shares list at the top of the price range, on a fully diluted basis.
articles.body_text: Anthropic intends to push ahead with its IPO despite shakier markets and the broader pullback from AI investing. The Claude-maker said in an updated IPO filing on Tuesday that it would be offering a total of 825 million Class A shares at an estimated price range of $70 to $78 per share. The sale is expected to raise anywhere from $57.75 billion to $64.35 billion. The company could end up being worth a hefty $1.404 trillion if its shares list at the top of the price range, on a fully diluted basis. That would represent a significant jump up from the $965 billion valuation Anthropic reached in a May fundraise , but it’s still lower than the $2 trillion the company was reportedly targeting a couple months ago. Separately, Anthropic said it had struck a deal to privately sell $26 billion of non-voting Class N stock at the IPO price to AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, Nvidia and TSMC. Google and Nvidia are investing $10 billion apiece. All up, Anthropic estimates net proceeds to reach somewhere between $84.6 billion and $93.7 billion (the latter if the IPO underwriters exercise their option to buy additional shares). Underwriters, including Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley, will have the option to buy up to 123.75 million more shares from Anthropic at the IPO price. As a public benefit corporation, the founders hold a Class F share with 50.1% of the voting power. The Long-Term Benefit Trust will also elect a board majority, so Class A buyers will have limited influence. Anthropic intends to start trading on the Nasdaq close to November 19, per reporting from CNBC , under the ticker symbol “ANT”. The company expects up to 20% of the offering to be allocated to retail investors. Anthropic also gave out a few new details in the updated filing. The company said its run-rate revenue reached $81 billion by the end of October, about $10 billion more than at the end of September. Also, the filing now lists how many shares the company’s co-founders expect to sell in the IPO: CEO Dario Amodei, president and chairperson Daniela Amodei, chief compute officer Tom Brown, Anthropic Institute head Jack Clark, chief science officer Jared Kaplan, chief architect Sam McCandlish and interpretability research lead Christopher Olah are all selling nearly 3.4 million shares each. At the $74 midpoint of the IPO price range, that would land them about $250 million each. The updated filing also has a small but important change that hints at the company’s stance towards the Trump administration: the company at many points uses “super intelligence” and “SI” interchangeably with “artificial intelligence” and “AI,” citing Trump’s executive order from September that directed government departments and agencies to use that new terminology to refer to AI. The company’s third-quarter revenue came in at $17 billion, and nine-month revenue was $33.2 billion. The company reported a nine-month net loss of $104 billion, with compute and infrastructure commitments hitting $900.9 billion. It has nearly $132 billion in cash and short-term investments.

articles.title: Ring, known for its doorbell cameras, launches a home security drone and an enterprise security robot | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Amazon-owned Ring is pushing into robotics with the launch of a home security drone and a rolling robot designed to patrol and protect businesses.
articles.body_text: Ring, the Amazon-owned home security company, is launching its own robotics division, with an eye toward automating security at both the home and the office. The company announced Ring Robotics on Tuesday, debuting two new devices that are sure to stir more than a little bit of controversy. The first new device is a home security drone that users will be able to deploy to patrol their domiciles when they’re out. The other item that the company is launching is a roving enterprise security robot, designed for businesses. First, the drone. Ring calls the device a “flying indoor security camera” — which should give you a pretty good idea of what it’s supposed to do and how it’s supposed to work. Ring Drone Cam is designed to fly from room to room, inspecting what is happening in a user’s house and, if there’s trouble, to alert them. It has been built to integrate with Ring’s other home security devices so, for instance, if a Ring alarm goes off in a particular part of the home (say, the backdoor), the bot will supposedly fly to that location and investigate. When it’s not in use, the drone stays inactive in a docking bay. The drone shoots video in 2K and it also comes equipped with LED lights so that it can keep watch at night and record video in low light. It can be controlled via Amazon’s Alexa Home Map , and the bot can also be scheduled to patrol the house at specific times — so, if you know you’re going to be out for the night or even on vacation, the drone can keep you apprised of what’s happening while you’re away. Now, let’s turn to Ring Rover Cam. Like the drone, this roving robot can be set to patrol specific routes, at specific times, within the user’s business. The robot streams video in continuous 4K, which is viewable via Ring’s mobile app, and a trigger can be set to automatically record if it detects a human. It also comes with a periscope camera, which can be adjusted to see over specific obstacles, and it also includes two-way audio — meaning that, should the remote user need to communicate with a person at the store (be that an employee or a burglar), they can speak to them through the robot. Ring says that both robots are powered by the same proprietary AI system, known as AI Pilot. The company says this system leverages “specialized vision models, sensors, and cloud processing to see, think, and navigate autonomously.” Both devices, using this software, are designed to develop a detailed schematic of your house or office purely by exploring the space for themselves, the company says. “Together, it’s like having a guard on patrol who never clocks out,” the company claims, of its new devices. “Ring Rover can do a sweep of the floor after close and investigate when sensor trips at 2 a.m. — streaming it all to your phone, wherever you are.” Automated security is one space the tech industry has never quite cracked. In 2021, Amazon launched its own home security robot, known as Astro. Astro, which resembles Ring’s new robot (the company says that it was inspired to create the bot because of “feedback from Amazon Astro customers”), was first announced as a kind of nebulous domestic helper before being repurposed as an enterprise security product. The device never took off, however, and seven months into the robot’s glow-up as a small business security guard, Amazon put the device out to pasture . The Rover is being made available starting on December 16 and it will retail at a whopping $1,000. The drone, meanwhile, won’t launch until next year, on January 27, and will be made available for $270. When you purchase through links in our articles, we may earn a small commission . articles.title: California's proposed 'billionaire tax' fails to pass | TechCrunch
articles.summary: California voters rejected Proposition 40, the one-time 5% tax on billionaires, the AP reported Monday. Tech leaders outspent backers roughly 10 to 1 to defeat it, and the founders and economists TechCrunch interviewed before the vote were split on whether it would have driven out wealthy residents or just trimmed their fortunes.
articles.body_text: California voters have rejected Proposition 40, the state’s proposed one-time tax on billionaires, the Associated Press reported Monday . The measure failed after an expensive campaign that pitted labor unions against some of tech’s wealthiest figures. It was also opposed by Gov. Gavin Newsom. Nic Carter lives about as far from Silicon Valley as you can get within the continental U.S. but his feelings about California’s proposed tax on billionaires couldn’t have been stronger. Carter, a Floridian, and a general partner at the crypto-focused venture capital firm Castle Island Ventures, told TechCrunch before the vote that he thought the proposal — it was on the ballot during California’s midterm election last week — would actually have been a huge win for more fiscally conservative states like his own. “I think it’d be it would be great for Florida and Texas if these kinds of taxes pass,” Carter said last week. “I think it’s a shame, frankly, that California has this sort of semi-monopoly on capital formation, and that it’s being squandered by local governance that’s super dysfunctional.” Proposition 40, otherwise known as the California “billionaire’s tax,” was a ballot measure that proposed the creation of a special one-time 5% wealth tax to be levied against state residents with a net worth of more than $1 billion. The tax, which would have been applied retroactively to anyone who was residing in California on January 1, 2026, would have been used to fund a number of public programs — most notably Medi-Cal, the state’s Medicaid program that provides healthcare to qualifying low-income residents. Proponents of the proposal — largely labor unions — said it would have inconvenienced a tiny number of state residents, as California has a little over 200 billionaires who own a cumulative total of approximately $2 trillion in wealth. In return, they said, it would generate massive amounts of revenue. Its backers projected it could have raised as much as $100 billion over five years, the likes of which could then have been used to support public healthcare and education. But opponents argued that it would scare California’s wealthiest residents out of the state and ultimately disincentivize growth. The capital flight argument — that California’s upper crust would permanently flee, thus draining a more consistent source of revenue for the state — dominated conversations online among business leaders in the run-up to the vote. A critical but contested analysis published before the vote claimed the proposal would actually have lost the state money over time. “You’re signaling to the entrepreneur class that you consider them a resource to be plundered,” he said. Carter, who frequently works in San Francisco with tech startups, claimed such a tax would “inhibit venture capital investment” because VCs “wouldn’t necessarily want to invest in a company if they knew the founder was going to have to liquidate a huge percentage of their shares.” The logic: since many billionaires keep a majority of their wealth tied to their companies, it would be inconvenient for newly minted billionaires to make liquid a certain percentage of that wealth just so that they could pay the tax. Jesse Tinsely, a California entrepreneur who has spent his life working in startups, agreed. Tinsely is the co-founder and CEO of Mainstreet, a fintech holding company that owns employment sites like Employer.com and Recruiter.com. Tinsely founded his first startup many years ago and said that, based on his own experience, what he had accomplished wouldn’t have been possible with the proposed tax. Additionally, he reiterated a widely held fear — that founders, who could be taxed on their corporate assets, would be incentivized to give up control over their companies. “I bootstrapped my business. I have super voting shares, and I came from a [background as a] college dropout [and] broke firefighter with bad credit and whatnot, and built a business that’s valued into the billions,” Tinsely said last week. “I think it [the tax] removes the ability to do something like that.” Tinsely said he felt the proposed tax “forces founders to opt into a system” where “anyone who wants to become an entrepreneur has to…raise money or some type of capital, or move. Those are basically the only two options.”

articles.title: A short seller flagged Nvidia CEO's ties to a suspected Chinese spy six months before the scandal | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Six months before Nvidia's spy scandal erupted, Culper Research was already questioning Jensen Huang's unusually close relationship with a Chinese executive.
articles.body_text: Six months before the Nvidia spy scandal emerged , the New York-based short seller firm Culper Research had already raised questions about Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s unusually close relationship with Alice Huang, an executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company that buys Nvidia chips. She is now suspected to be a Chinese spy. The Nvidia CEO admitted to an extramarital affair over the weekend, and the company has now opened a formal investigation into his relationship with Alice Huang (who shares his last name but is not related). U.S. intelligence officials believe she was recruited by the Chinese government to collect intelligence on Jensen Huang and influence his position regarding U.S. export controls on advanced AI chips. Culper’s May 13 report is resurfacing because it picked up on the connection between Jensen Huang and Alice Huang while investigating Megaspeed’s ties to Nvidia. NEW: We are short Nvidia $NVDA . We believe Nvidia has a significant China problem. Please see our full report and disclosures now available on our website, link in bio. pic.twitter.com/oTaJyL7S2R In particular, the report called the relationship between the two executives “uncomfortably close,” noting that the Nvidia CEO was spotted partying and socializing with Alice Huang on multiple occasions. The report even claimed that some Nvidia employees wondered whether they had a “special relationship.” Culper Research also theorized the China business that Nvidia lost to export controls had been rerouted through Southeast Asia, and that Megaspeed, a major chip buyer in the region, was secretly financed by Chinese tech giant Alibaba through shell companies. It pointed to financial records that showed Megaspeed’s total liabilities and equity had grown from $33 million at the end of 2023 to around $3 billion by the end of 2024, much of it in the form of refundable deposits from an unidentified source. Financial Times reported Monday that documents show Alibaba lent money to Megaspeed through subsidiaries. Culper is a short seller, so it stood to financially benefit from making these allegations, and those about possible illegal chip diversion have not been independently verified. articles.title: The race is on to sue Nvidia | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Nvidia’s stock slid more than 4% after its board opened an investigation into Jensen Huang’s relationship with a suspected Chinese spy, and one securities law expert says the company’s earlier insistence that it was all “normal” could turn into a very expensive problem.
articles.body_text: Nvidia’s stock slid more than 4% on Monday, the first trading day after its board said it would investigate CEO Jensen Huang over his relationship with Alice Huang, an executive U.S. intelligence believes was spying for China. Securities lawyers were already moving. At least four firms, including Schall, Brown & Schwartz and Levi & Korsinsky, announced investigations Monday into whether Nvidia misled investors. Robert Bartlett, a Stanford Law professor and securities law expert, expects them to have plenty of company. “I would definitely wager that there’ll be a filing,” Bartlett said in an interview Monday morning, adding that he wouldn’t be surprised if a case had been filed by the end of the day. Plaintiffs’ lawyers have good reasons to be first in line; under federal securities law, the first complaint triggers a public notice, and investors then have 60 days to ask the court to be named lead plaintiff. A firm that files early gets a head start on signing up investors with large losses, as well as on shaping the story of the case. Bartlett was right, in fact. A case surfaced Monday afternoon in the Northern District of California, where Nvidia is headquartered. Rosen Law Firm, a New York-based plaintiffs’ firm that specializes in securities class actions, filed it on behalf of Mark Kistenmacher, a retail investor who made seven purchases totaling roughly $20,500 this year, according to a schedule attached to the complaint. (Rosen was lead counsel in a $250 million settlement with Alibaba and ranks among the most active filers of such cases.) The proposed class covers anyone who bought Nvidia securities between Oct. 9, 2025, and Nov. 8, 2026, and the suit names both Nvidia and Huang. The complaint accuses them of misleading investors about Huang’s ties to Megaspeed, the Singapore-based data center outfit where Alice Huang was considered a top exec, and it points to three statements as proof: Nvidia spokesperson John Rizzo’s late-October claim that Huang’s interactions with Alice Huang were “not unusual or unexpected,” the company’s even earlier claim that it found “ no evidence of diversion ” of its chips, and Jensen Huang’s Oct. 30 comment to Bloomberg that Nvidia’s dealings with Megaspeed were “ normal and not unusual .” All three were false or misleading, the suit says, because Huang was having an affair with Alice Huang. Kistenmacher is asking for unspecified damages, interest and attorneys’ fees, and he wants a jury trial. While much remains unknown, the legal theory here doesn’t depend on anything the board’s investigation may turn up about Huang’s private life. When The New York Times first reported on Huang’s ties to Alice Huang last month, Rizzo really did tell the Times that the relationship was “ not unusual or unexpected .” Rizzo separately told another outlet , The Hill, that “Megaspeed has been no different than many other regional cloud customers. Meetings with customers are part of a CEO’s job; Jensen talks with thousands of customer executives every year.” Of course, the world now knows that was not true. Worse, the Times reports that U.S. intelligence had been monitoring Alice Huang for more than a year. From a securities perspective, Bartlett said, the company’s earlier statement was “clearly a misleading statement.” And because Huang is CEO, Bartlett said, “his knowledge gets imputed to the company.” In other words, Nvidia is treated as having known what its chief executive knew. The Kistenmacher complaint makes the same argument. Bartlett predicted a “classic fraud on the market” claim, in which investors argue they paid prices that reflected false or incomplete public information, and lost money when the truth emerged. This early lawsuit relies on that theory, and Monday’s drop of $7.97 per share, or 4.27%, gives the attorneys involved a lot to work with. Damages in such cases are tied to the stock’s decline, and Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies in the world, so you can imagine a settlement could prove exceedingly expensive. That means a large payment from the company and its directors-and-officers insurers, but typically no personal consequences for the CEO or the board. It is also a civil matter, so Huang isn’t facing prison over it. The irony, as Bartlett noted, is that the suit is brought in the name of Nvidia’s shareholders, and shareholders ultimately pay for the settlement, directly or through insurance premiums.

articles.title: Anthropic releases new Mythos and Fable models amid RSI concerns | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Anthropic says the new models "show improvements in areas like coding, reasoning, and vision," as well as in communicating more clearly with users.
articles.body_text: Anthropic released new versions of its most advanced models on Monday, with the launch of Mythos 5.2 and Fable 5.2. The company says the new models “show improvements in areas like coding, reasoning, and vision” and communicate more clearly with users. Notably, Anthropic is lowering the cost of Fable from $10 to $8 per million input tokens. As a result, Fable 5.2 is now cheaper than its primary competitor GPT-6 Astra. Anthropic says that the new version of Fable will return responses 30% faster across effort levels. Faster inference serving is available for double the price. Fable 5.2 is also compatible with zero data retention (ZDR) policies through the Enterprise Frontier Safeguards system , long a sticking point for many enterprise clients. It’s Anthropic’s first model release since the arrival of a third-party report from the assessment group METR , which suggested the lab might be approaching recursive self-improvement (RSI) — or the ability for AI models to carry on model training independently. The METR report found internal models were speeding up Anthropic’s AI progress by roughly 2x, although many uncertainties remain. Still, Anthropic’s release notes significant ongoing challenges in accurately testing model capabilities. “Claude Mythos 5.2 and Fable 5.2 each voice suspicion that they are being evaluated more often than any of our recent models, which challenges our ability to assess how they will act in real-world settings. As these settings expand and capabilities increase with future models, we expect this challenge to grow.” Anthropic maintains that the new version of Mythos does not have the ability to act covertly against its user, a verdict that’s detailed further in Mythos 5.2’s system card . “Claude Mythos 5.2 shows stronger covert capabilities than prior Claude models on several of our evaluations, particularly when its reasoning is hidden from the monitor,” the system card reads. “That said, we believe that low levels of absolute performance on our new covert evaluations support claims that rely on detection of harmful actions in high-stakes situations.” Fable 5.2 has been available to select parties in pre-release for some time, and Anthropic says the model has already “solved two open problems in theoretical physics, formalized Fermat’s Last Theorem, and supported numerous other research projects.” Also on Monday, AI startup Physical Superintelligence announced a new proof of the Aaronson‑Ambainis conjecture, a pivotal step in setting theoretical limits for quantum computing. Notably, the lab said the result was achieved by running “a non-public Anthropic model” within PSI’s own system. Anthropic did not confirm or deny whether Fable 5.2 was the model in question. articles.summary: Smaller and faster RAM with up to 128GB transfer speed scould be on the way thanks to research from IBM and MIcron, using stacked chips and TSVs.
articles.body_text: Smaller and faster RAM with up to 128GBps transfer speeds could be on the way thanks to research from IBM and MIcron. The companies have developed three-dimensional memory, stacking individual DRAM chips vertically that would normally have to be placed side-by-side, though the efficiencies gained aren’t solely down to space. Communication between the stacked chips and the host device is achieved through a new creation known as through-silicon vias, or TSVs, which run vertically through the pile of chips and act as conduits to the host device. Thanks to the TSVs, in testing the memory has reached data speeds of 128GBps, ten times faster than current memory. On top of this, IBM claims the chips are 70 percent more power efficient than today’s DRAM. The new research is expected to form a key part of Samsung and Micron’s Hybrid Memory Cube technology, first announced back in October. IBM and Micron hope to have commercial availability in two years, with servers likely to use it first. Looking beyond that, IBM fellow Subu Iyer said that the new process “will have applications beyond memory, enabling other industry segments as well.” What exactly those new segments are remains to be seen, but we certainly wouldn’t complain if our computers got the kind of speed bump described here.

Den kan lika gärna vara bitter kyla – och älgar. – I somras förstod vi att det finns regnskog i Sverige, säger ekologen Alexander Nilsson, till Svenska Dagbladet. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Har annars bara setts i nederbördsrika kustområden. I Sverige kallar vi den kort och gott bara för skogen. Fast det massiva täcket av skog som breder ut sig över Skandinavien, Ryssland och nordligaste delarna av Nordamerika benämns även som tajgan, eller som de boreala skogarna. Mindre vanligt är att kalla den för regnskog. Men kanske är det dags nu. För en grupp svenska och norska biologer är säkra på sin sak: de har hittat regnskog – i Sverige. Närmare bestämt i Jämtland . – Det är väldigt mycket i både svensk och norsk natur som fortfarande finns att upptäcka, säger ekologen Alexander Nilsson från norska naturvårdsstiftelsen Biofokus, till Svenska Dagbladet . Den nordliga, boreala regnskogen finns oftast vid nederbördsrika kusttrakter i Nordamerika och i Norge. Hittills har man inte kunnat definiera skogspartier som regnskog i Sverige. Tills nu.

articles.title: C-ledaren: Finns inget jag föredrar
articles.summary: Centerpartiet har vågmästarroll i regeringsbildningen. Men partiledaren vägrar svara på om de ska gå höger eller vänster. – Det finns ingenting jag föredrar utan det finns massa alternativ som diskuteras just nu, säger Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist.
articles.body_text: Centerpartiet har vågmästarroll i regeringsbildningen. Men partiledaren vägrar svara på om de ska gå höger eller vänster. – Det finns ingenting jag föredrar utan det finns massa alternativ som diskuteras just nu, säger Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. 60 dagar har gått sedan valet utan att en ny regering tillträtt. Sonderingsuppdraget ligger hos Moderaternas Ulf Kristersson – men den rödgröna sidan har fortfarande förhoppningar om att kunna bilda regering. Problemet: Ett C som vägrar ha V i regering – och ett V som vägrar en regering de inte sitter i. På tisdagseftermiddagen samlades flera av partiernas riksdagsgrupper för att diskutera den pågående regeringsbildningen. Mycket hänger på Centerpartiet som i sin vågmästarroll kan vara avgörande för att bilda en höger- eller vänsterregering. Sedan SD släppte sitt krav på att sitta i regering finns högerhopp om att C ska ansluta till de gamla allianspartierna i en minoritetsregering, som skulle tolereras av SD i en omröstning. Enligt uppgifter till Expressen är Centerpartiet splittrat hela vägen upp i toppen och partiledare Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist uppges vilja gå åt höger. Utåt ger hon ett annat besked. På tisdagen säger hon att det inte finns någon riktning som hon ”föredrar”, men att de röda linjerna mot V och SD ligger kvar. – Vi diskuterar våra olika möjligheter. Det finns ingenting jag föredrar utan det finns massa alternativ som diskuteras just nu, säger hon. Vad Centerpartiet sagt i förhandlingar med S och V vill hon inte kommentera alls. Hon vill inte heller gå in på vilka eftergifter partiet hade varit redo att göra för att komma överens med V om.

articles.title: Expert om tempot: ”Nu börjar allvaret”
articles.summary: En veckas sondering och sen votering – talman Andreas Norlén gick offensivt ut. Men i den tredje rundan har han växlat ner. statsvetaren Jonas Hinnfors.
articles.body_text: En veckas sondering och sen votering – talman Andreas Norlén gick ut offensivt. Men i den tredje rundan har han växlat ner. – Det är nu det börjar bli på allvar, säger statsvetaren Jonas Hinnfors. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Både Magdalena Andersson (S) och Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist (C) fick omkring en vecka på sig att sondera innan de ställdes inför omröstning i riksdagskammaren. Initialt fick även Ulf Kristersson (M) en vecka. Han bad dock om mer tid i fredags och talmannen gav honom ”ytterligare några dagar” att föra samtal. Kristersson ska redovisa tillbaka till talmannen den 17 november. Det är inte konstigt att talman Andreas Norlén valde att bromsa ner regeringsprocessen, menar Jonas Hinnfors, professor emeritus i statsvetenskap på Göteborgs universitet. – Det är inte förrän den tredje, fjärde omgången som det börjar bli på allvar. Om talmannen får minsta indikation på att någon av statsministerkandidaterna får vind på seglet i förhandlingar kommer han nog att ge dem extra tid för att komma i hamn, säger han. Fram tills nu har talmannen mest ”lappat efter läge” medan partierna ”lurpassat efter varandra”, enligt Hinnfors. – Det är nästan inbyggt hos partierna att man avvaktar de första omgångarna. Och det är inte talmannens fel, utan grundlagens. Det är ett komplicerat förhandlingsspel men alla vet att efter fjärde omröstningen blir det automatiskt extraval, säger han. Talmannens initialt offensiva strategi har bytts ut mot att läsa av signaler från partierna. Rent formellt kan han förlänga sonderingsuppdragen hur länge han vill, enligt Hinnfors. – Förhandlingar kan ibland behöva lite tid, men nu har de ändå hållit på rätt länge. Jag har svårt att se att han förlänger sonderingsuppdrag med mer än två veckor, säger han.

articles.title: JUST NU: Ger Kristersson en vecka till
articles.summary: Talmannen har förlängt Ulf Kristerssons sonderingsuppdrag. Nu uppger M-ledaren att han försöker bilda regering med C, KD och L – och att samtal pågår. Samtidigt riktar Kristersson kritik mot S. ”Så agerar bara ett parti i affekt och desperation”, skriver han på Facebook.
articles.body_text: Talmannen har förlängt Ulf Kristerssons sonderingsuppdrag. Nu uppger M-ledaren att han försöker bilda regering med C, KD och L – och att samtal pågår. Samtidigt riktar Kristersson kritik mot S. ”Så agerar bara ett parti i affekt och desperation”, skriver han på Facebook. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Den nuvarande statsministern Ulf Kristersson (M) skulle egentligen ha rapporterat sitt sonderingsuppdrag till talman Andreas Norlén senast i dag, den 10 november. Men i fredags förlängde talmannen uppdraget ”med ytterligare några dagar beroende på händelseutvecklingen”. Norlén syftar då på beskedet från Jimmie Åkesson, om att SD släpper sitt krav på ministerposter , och på C-ledaren Elisabeth Thand Ringqvists efterföljande krav på två politiska ”totalpaket” från S och M. Nu redovisar talmannen att Kristerssons uppdrag sträcker sig till den 17 november, det vill säga nästa tisdag. – Jag är mån om en väl förankrad process och för löpande samtal med olika partiföreträdare, men efter rapporten från Ulf Kristersson kommer jag att samtala med samtliga övriga partiföreträdare för att få en samlad bild av var processen för regeringsbildningen då befinner sig, säger Andreas Norlén i en kommentar. Efter detta kommer talmannen meddela nästa steg i processen, uppger han. Ulf Kristersson skriver på Facebook att han efter den 17 november står ”till förfogande” för en statsministeromröstning om det är vad talmannen bestämmer.

articles.title: Mohamsson: Tror att Andersson avgår
articles.summary: Simona Mohamsson dömer ut Magdalena Anderssons regeringschans – och räknar med att S-ledaren avgår. Hon öppnar samtidigt famnen för Centerpartiet.
articles.body_text: Simona Mohamsson dömer ut Magdalena Anderssons regeringschans – och räknar med att S-ledaren avgår. Hon öppnar samtidigt famnen för Centerpartiet. – Sossekrossen är hård, men jag hoppas Elisabeth är stark nog att stå emot, säger L-ledaren. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Kampen om regeringsmakten pågår för fullt just nu. Centerpartiet har uppmanat Magdalena Andersson (S) och Ulf Kristersson (M) att senast på fredag presentera varsitt ”totalpaket” till C. Därefter ska C avgöra vilken statsminister man vill se. Liberalernas partiledare Simona Mohamsson hoppas att C-ledaren Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist och hennes partikamrater ska ta steget högerut. Hon tycker att C:s plats naturligt finns där. – Det finns en samsyn i sakpolitik i viktiga frågor om ekonomin, hur vi ser på människors ansträngning, på den lön de har jobbat ihop och hur vi ser på företagens villkor, säger Mohamsson, och tillägger: – Det är ingen slump att Centerpartiet betydligt oftare har röstat med Tidöpartierna än Socialdemokraterna i riksdagen under den gångna mandatperioden. Simona Mohamsson slår fast att S-trycket mot Thand Ringqvist nu är stenhårt, men att hon hoppas att C-ledaren ska stå emot ”och göra det som är bäst för Sverige”. På tisdagen stod det klart att Magdalena Andersson har bett talmannen om att inte låta riksdagen rösta om Ulf Kristersson , som just nu har sonderingsuppdraget, om han inte presenterar ett regeringsunderlag. Själv är Andersson beredd att sondera, och få mer tid till samtalen om en rödgrön regering.

articles.title: Sigtunaskolans drag: Avvecklar ett internat
articles.summary: En skandal med grova brott har skakat Sigtuna humanistiska läroverket. Nu avvecklar de sitt veckointernat, enligt SVT Stockholm.
articles.body_text: En skandal med grova brott har skakat Sigtuna humanistiska läroverket. Enligt internatchefen Mazdak Sarvari har förändringen ”inte något med utredningen att göra”. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Från och med 2027 avvecklar Sigtuna humanistiska läroverket sitt veckointernat, enligt ett mejl till vårdnadshavarna som SVT Stockholm tagit del av. ”För elever som redan idag har veckointernat gäller dock att de får behålla sitt nuvarande boendealternativ under hela sin återstående studietid” , skriver skolan i mejlet. Skolan har tre olika internatformer. Ett veckointernat där eleverna kan åka hem om helgerna, ett heltidsinernat där elever stannar alla helger och ett traditionellt internat som innebär att eleverna reser hem vissa helger. Skolans internatchef Mazdak Sarvari förtydligar att de övriga internatformerna kommer att finnas kvar. ”Det här är en sedan länge planerad förändring som inte har något med utredningen att göra” , skriver han och fortsätter: ”Ingen elev påverkas då elever med veckointernat får fortsätta med boendeformen tills de tar studenten”. Tre manliga elever i 18-årsåldern har häktats misstänkta för grova brott som ägt rum på skolan i oktober. De misstänks bland annat för grovt sexuellt ofredande, grovt olaga tvång och grov misshandel. Brotten ska ha begåtts inom ramen för en ”maktstruktur” där äldre elever styr yngre genom kontroll och bestraffningar, enligt åklagaren. Flera elever har vittnat om en hård miljö på skolan med bestraffningssystem, förnedringsritualer och tystnadskultur.

articles.title: Gent, 19, sköts ihjäl – nu döms 16-åring
articles.summary: 16-åring skickades till Uppsala för att mörda en 22-åring. Istället sköts 19-årige Gent Maksutaj på öppen gata. Nu döms pojken till fängelse för mordet.
articles.body_text: På sommarlovet skickades en 16-åring till Uppsala för att mörda en utpekad måltavla. Efter flera dagars jakt mötte han i stället 19-årige Gent Maksutaj – och dirigerades först att skjuta honom och sedan att gå tillbaka för att avsluta mordet. Nu döms 16-åringen till fängelse i fyra år och 6 månader för mordet. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. 19-årige Gent Maksutaj hade precis tagit studenten och planerade för framtiden. Den 5 juli i år sköts han ihjäl på öppen gata i Uppsala . Skytten var en 16-årig pojke som hade skickats till staden för att utföra ett morduppdrag. Måltavlan ska egentligen ha varit en 22-årig Uppsalabo som 16-åringen aldrig hade träffat. Han hade bara fått en bild skickad till sin telefon. ”Memorisera ansiktet”, skrev en av uppdragsgivarna. Via den krypterade appen Signal styrdes 16-åringen till olika platser. Planen var att locka fram måltavlan genom att låtsas köpa narkotika. Men försöken misslyckades, pressen ökade och uppdragsgivarna blev allt mer hotfulla. – Då var de ganska arga. De bara; ja men ta den som kommer, har 16-åringen sagt i förhör. Nu döms 16-åringen i Uppsala tingsrätt till fängelse i fyra år och sex månader för mord, förberedelse till mord, grovt vapenbrott samt brott mot lagen om brandfarliga och explosiva varor.

articles.title: Åkesson: Då kan vi samarbeta – med S
articles.summary: SD-ledaren vill förhandla budget
articles.body_text: En ny Kristersson-regering behöver söka stöd hos SD för att få igenom sin budget, enligt Jimmie Åkesson. – Det är inte osannolikt att man får ett visst inflytande, säger SD-ledaren. I framtiden öppnar han för samarbeten med S. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. I fredags meddelade Jimmie Åkesson att Sverigedemokraterna släpper sitt ministerkrav och kan tolerera en moderatledd fyrpartiregering, med M, KD, L och C. Samtidigt skulle SD sannolikt ha ett inflytande över en sådan regering, som vågmästare i riksdagen. S-ledaren Magdalena Andersson stängde nyligen dörren för att samarbeta med en minoritetsregering till höger. – Vill de ha stöd för sin budget får de söka stöd i riksdagen och kommer att behöva göra det sannolikt. Då är vi en part som är öppen för förhandling, säger Åkesson vid en träff med riksdagsjournalister. Manövern att tolerera en högerregering och gå i opposition var Jimmie Åkessons egen idé och hölls i en väldigt snäv krets. SD-ledaren utesluter inte att använda sig av riksdagens missförtroendeförklaring för att fälla en ny alliansregering, om den bedriver en skadlig politik. – Men det har lite kärnvapenkaraktär, säger han. En av poängerna med att gå i opposition är att kunna förhandla även med Socialdemokraterna, om det blir aktuellt, säger Jimmie Åkesson. Han beskriver SD som ett tredje block utanför vänster- och högerblock i svensk politik.

articles.body_text: Vimmerbybon döms till fem och ett halvt års fängelse för sin illegala gömma med 31 vapen och stora mängder ammunition. Under tisdagen dömdes Vimmerbybon i 35-årsåldern till fem och ett halvt års fängelse av Kalmar tingsrätt . Åklagaren hade yrkat på att mannen skulle dömas för synnerligen grovt vapenbrott för sina 31 vapen, som inbegrep gevär, pistol och kulspruta. Tingsrätten väljer dock att döma mannen för grovt vapenbrott för eftersom mannen inte hade några helautomatiska vapen. – Helautomatiska vapen är ojämförligt farligare än halvautomatiska sådana. Det måste därför krävas att omständigheterna i övrigt är väsentligt allvarligare för att innehav av halvautomatiska vapen ska bedömas som synnerligen grovt vapenbrott, än när fråga är om innehav av helautomatiska vapen, säger Robert Knutsson, rådman, i ett pressmeddelande. Vapengömman avslöjades i mannens bostad och i en lagerlokal som han hade tillgång till, vid årsskiftet, vilket Expressen berättade om under måndagen. Förutom vapnen hade mannen en mängd nazistföremål som hakkorsflagga, Hitlerbyst och tygmärken med nazistiska symboler. ”Mannen hade även gjort dokumenterade uttalanden av nazistisk och antisemitisk karaktär”, skriver tingsrätten i pressmeddelandet. – Jag är inte politisk om det är det du frågar, det är jag inte. Samlargrejer, kommenterade Vimmerbybon nazisamlingen under polisförhör. ”Utredningen ger heller inget stöd för att mannen varit aktiv i den högerextrema miljön även om det finns omständigheter som talar för att han sympatiserar med dylika åsikter”, skriver tingsrätten.

articles.body_text: Den svenska möbeljätten Kinnarps möbelfabriker har utsatts för en hackerattack, det rapporterar SVT Väst . Intrånget ska ha upptäckts i lördags. På måndagen stoppade företaget all produktion i Kinnarp, Jönköping och Skillingaryd. Bolagets hemsida ligger nere och man har stängt ner sina servrar under tiden analys och utredning pågår. Det sker mycket i politiken just nu med uttalanden från höger och vänster. Detta har hänt den senaste timmen: • C-ledaren Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist vill inte svara på om partiet tänker gå höger eller vänster. Hon säger att det inte finns någonting hon "föredrar" men att de röda linjerna mot SD och V ligger fast. • Moderaternas Ulf Kristersson får förlängt sonderingsuppdrag till den 17 november. På sociala medier riktar han en hård känga mot Socialdemokraterna "hårda ord". "Så agerar bara ett parti i affekt och desperation” , skriver han. • S-ledaren Magdalena Andersson tror att det fortfarande finns chans för henne att bli statsminister. Samtidigt har det gått åtta veckor sedan valet utan att hon kunnat presentera en regering. – Det har gått tid. Jag förstår att många undrar vad sjutton vi håller på med. Men det är ett komplicerat läge i riksdagen just nu och det är bättre att det går bra än fort, säger hon. Europa bör se till att utse en representant till kommande förhandlingar med Ryssland. Det säger den ukrainske presidenten Volodymyr Zelenskyj vid sitt besök i Danmark. – Nu är det dags att man väljer en person, alla kommer såklart att vara representerade, alla är förstås väldigt viktiga, men vi kan inte ha 40 personer som pratar med Putin, säger Zelenskyj i ett samtal med en dansk journalist och statsminister Mette Frederiksen på Köpenhamns universitet på tisdagen. Danmarks statsminister Mette Frederiksen svarar att hon inte är intresserad av att vara "Europas röst". – Vi kommer att ha ett samtal om det senare i kväll (tisdag) och i Dublin, säger hon, och syftar på toppmötet EPC (Europeiska politiska gemenskapen), som kommer att hållas i Irlands huvudstad senare i veckan. (TT) 60 dagar har gått sedan valet utan att en ny regering tillträtt. S-ledaren Magdalena Andersson säger att det behövs mer tid.
